title: The line that minimizes squared error
lede: Drag the points. The red line minimizes the total area of the squares built on the vertical residuals. Turn on your own line and try to get a smaller total.
notice: Each red square has side equal to one residual, so the sum of squared errors is literally the total shaded area.
Move your own line anywhere: its total area is never below the least-squares value. It matches only when your line coincides with the red one.
R squared is 1 minus the error area divided by the spread around the mean height. It is near 1 when the points hug the line.
hint: Drag the dots. Turn on 'Try my own line' and adjust its sliders.
